scope: Source-only check of actual text/raw responsibility training path, not a new runtime probe.
findings: The training loop performs scaled backward, unscale, finite-gradient assertion, optimizer step and scale update. It has no full-model gradient clipping operation.
The loop asserts the scale never decreases; this is a code requirement, not this check's independent verification of every recorded update.
The role head uses detached head parameters and cloned buffers. Gradient ownership and identical global optimization trajectories are separate claims.
conclusion: Do not attribute the observed RGBNT100 same-epoch own-global difference to full-model clipping or a silently tolerated scale decrease. No first divergent operation or unique cause was established; no optimizer/AMP/head modification is justified by this check alone.
boundary: No NN, remote progress query, reconstruction, new score, production edit, candidate registration, or claim of strict global preservation across all datasets.
